gates.name: Real Network Socket Server Binding

gates.evidence: RealNetworkServer spawned, Uvicorn running on TCP socket, authenticated HTTP client requests verified.

gates.name: Server Restart & Network Durability Across Socket
gates.target: Socket death, process termination, restart on same SQLite DB
gates.evidence: Socket killed, verified connection refused, restarted server, monotonic event sequence maintained with zero data loss.

gates.name: Socket-Level Duplicate Idempotency & ACK Drop
gates.evidence: Identical event payload submitted twice over TCP socket; 200 OK returned with zero duplicate storage.

gates.name: Real Tool Replication Over REST

gates.name: Real Experience Replication Over REST

gates.name: Concurrent Bidirectional Convergence Over REST
gates.evidence: 50 unique events pushed and pulled concurrently across two client threads; 100% convergence achieved.

gates.name: Network Flapping Resilience (10 Cycles)

gates.name: Large Backlog Monotonicity (1,000 Events)
